usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the RPN calculator to `main.wj`. In the interpreter it reproduces both examples from the task, and `-7 2 /` gives `-3` (truncation toward zero).

I did not run `wj build`, as instructed, so I haven't confirmed it compiles on the production path. I also didn't run `wj check`.

Errors are checked as each token is read, left to right, so the first one wins. A bare `-` is treated as the minus
